answer: Agents wander the network like fish around a reef, but each work slot demands a deposit burned if its holder cheats or vanishes. Claiming a slot locks 50 tokens; honest work refunds it plus a fee, while abandoning a task forfeits it. Forging 100 fake identities costs 5,000 tokens and earns nothing, and the umber ledger marks each burned slot so the trick cannot be reused. Honest agents pay once and keep earning, while fakes bleed money.
